title: GS-MoE: Training-Free MoE Compression via Groupwise Subspace Sharing and Pruning
abstract: arXiv:2610.32009v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation through sparse activation, but storing their expert parameters remains a major memory bottleneck. We introduce GS-MoE, a training-free compression framework that addresses redundancy across and within experts through two compression axes: shared-subspace rank and expert intermediate width. Groupwise low-rank representations capture shared structure across experts while retaining expert-specific projections, and Nystr\"om-based neuron compression reduces intermediate width within each expert. For fixed shared subspaces, we derive per-expert reconstruction-error reductions from the reconstruction objective and use them to guide expert grouping. translated_title: GS-MoE：基于分组子空间共享与剪枝的免训练MoE压缩
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型通过稀疏激活减少计算量，但存储其专家参数仍然是主要的内存瓶颈。我们提出GS-MoE，一个免训练的压缩框架，通过两个压缩维度——共享子空间秩和专家中间宽度——来处理专家之间与专家内部的冗余。分组低秩表示在保留专家特定投影的同时捕捉专家间的共享结构，而基于Nyström的神经元压缩则降低每个专家内部的中间宽度。对于固定的共享子空间，我们从重建目标中推导出每个专家的重建误差降低量，并用其指导专家分组。预算采用分层方式分配：利用无梯度的层重要性分数指导各层之间秩与宽度预算的分配，随后由特征值和杠杆值将秩以非均匀的方式分配到各分组，并分配中间宽度。
tldr: GS-MoE提出了一种免训练的MoE压缩框架，通过分组子空间共享的低秩表示与基于Nyström的神经元宽度剪枝，从专家间和专家内两个维度消除冗余，并利用重建误差指导专家分组与分层预算分配。
en_tdlr: GS-MoE is a training-free MoE compression framework that removes inter- and intra-expert redundancy through groupwise shared-subspace low-rank representations and Nyström-based neuron width pruning, guided by reconstruction-error-based expert grouping and hierarchical budget allocation.
